toegepas.blok: 'n Dier hang van sy mense af
toegepas.voor: Dit kan ook nie in woorde
toegepas.na: Hy kan ook nie in woorde
toegepas.rede_vinder: The pronoun switches from 'Dit' to 'hy' within one sentence; the lesson otherwise refers to the animal as 'hy'.
toegepas.fout: The sentence opens with 'Dit' for the animal and then switches to 'hy' in the same sentence, while the block otherwise uses 'hy'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: A plain pronoun agreement fix that leaves the meaning untouched.

toegepas.na: het net soveel sorg nodig as 'n troeteldier.
toegepas.rede_vinder: Without 'as ...' the comparison is incomplete and 'net soveel' can be misread as 'only so much care'.
toegepas.fout: 'net soveel sorg' has no stated comparison, so the block read on its own leaves the reader asking 'as much as what?'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Names the comparison the context already implies (the previous block's pet) without adding any new fact, and removes the possible 'only so much' misreading.

toegepas.rede_vinder: The previous sentence refers to the DBV as 'dit', so 'Sy' is an unclear pronoun reference.
toegepas.fout: The DBV is 'dit' in the previous sentence and then 'Sy' here, so the reference wobbles.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming the DBV makes the reference unambiguous with no change of meaning, and the following 'Hulle' still points to the inspectors.

toegepas.rede_vinder: Animals do not 'kry 'n veearts'; they get a vet's care, which is what the sentence means.
toegepas.fout: Animals do not 'kry 'n veearts'; the list puts a person beside food and shelter as if he were a provision.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'hulp van 'n veearts' says what the sentence means in natural Afrikaans, and matches the glossary's sense of care.

laat_vaar.voor: as jy sien iets is fout met die dier
laat_vaar.na: as jy sien dat iets met die dier fout is
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Spoken main-clause order in a subordinate clause; standard written Afrikaans uses 'dat' with the verb at the end.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'as jy sien iets is fout' is natural spoken Afrikaans for Grade 6, matches the next block's heading 'As jy sien 'n dier word sleg behandel', and sits inside a who-to-tell safety instruction.

laat_vaar.voor: plekke wat seer wilde diere versorg
laat_vaar.na: plekke wat beseerde wilde diere versorg
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'seer' used attributively before a noun phrase reads unnaturally; 'beseerde' is the normal adjective for injured animals.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'seer diere' is used consistently in the lesson and in the shared veearts definition ('siek en seer diere'), and 'beseerde' narrows it to injury only.

laat_vaar.voor: Iemand wie se werk is om
laat_vaar.na: Iemand wie se werk dit is om
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The construction 'wie se werk dit is om' needs the placeholder 'dit'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'wie se werk is om te gaan kyk' is grammatical as it stands, so this is not a plain grammar error and a shared glossary definition should not be reworded.

na_skrywer.voor: Dit lyk dalk stiller. Tog ly die dier ook.
na_skrywer.na: Dit gebeur dalk stiller, maar die dier ly ook.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'Dit lyk stiller' is wooden (something cannot look quieter); joining the two short sentences with 'maar' reads more naturally, with the AWS comma.
na_skrywer.fout: 'Dit lyk dalk stiller' is stiff, pairing 'lyk' with an auditory word.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The proposal's 'gebeur stiller' moves the sense from how neglect appears to how it actually happens, which the 'Tog' contrast depends on, so the writer must find another fix.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.voor: Die wet noem ook uitdruklik om
na_skrywer.na: Die wet sê ook uitdruklik dat dit verbode is om
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'noem' cannot take an 'om ... te' infinitive as object; the sentence as written is ungrammatical.
na_skrywer.fout: 'Die wet noem ook uitdruklik om ... te gee nie' is ungrammatical: 'noem' cannot take an 'om ... te' clause as object.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fix adds a legal claim ('dat dit verbode is') that the original did not state, so the wording of what the law says belongs to the writer.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'Laat ... in hulle eie plek' copies English 'leave them in their place'; Afrikaans 'laat' needs a verb here.
na_skrywer.fout: 'Laat wilde diere ... in hulle eie plek' lacks the verb Afrikaans expects after 'laat' here.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The sentence is a safety instruction about what to do with wild animals, so even a better reading goes to the writer.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: Die bande en rieme waarmee 'n dier aan 'n kar vasgemaak word.
vlae.rede: 'bande' most often means tyres in Afrikaans, and the cart next to it invites that reading; a better word for the straps depends on what the harness is meant to include, so it is flagged rather than changed.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: Die doel is om so 'n dier terug te laat gaan
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: 'terug te laat gaan' names no destination (back to the wild/its natural habitat), which reads incomplete; the protected wording is left intact, but a person may want to consider whether the destination should be stated.
